description.value: Twisted rebar and shattered girders are handholds to you, not hazards. You can attempt to Grab an Edge to catch a fall off broken structures even without a free hand, using your weapon or a scavenged strap as an anchor.

cinderfall.incomplete: Attempting Grab an Edge without a free hand is a capability unlock (bypassing a stated action requirement), not a check modifier -- no rule element changes an action's own requirements.
